issue_context.title: Honeywell Lyric Integration only detects single setpoint temperature in auto mode
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When trying to adjust the the target min and max temperatures using `climate.set_temperature` service call on a Honeywell T9 thermostat configured using the Honeywell Lyric integration, the target min and max temperature does not get updated on the thermostat. Attempting to use the `temperature` parameter (instead of `target_temp_high`/`target_temp_low`) is "successful" at adjusting the target minimum temperature. The thermostat is set to "auto" mode, which should be equivalent to `heat_cool` so it should support dual temperature setting.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.3.0b6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

Honeywell Lyric

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://rc.home-assistant.io/integrations/lyric/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line
service: climate.set_temperature
target:
  entity_id: climate.hallway
data:
  target_temp_high: 83
  target_temp_low: 63

# State info
hvac_modes:
  - 'off'
  - heat
  - cool
  - heat_cool
min_temp: 50
max_temp: 90
preset_modes:
  - NoHold
  - HoldUntil
  - PermanentHold
  - TemporaryHold
  - VacationHold
current_temperature: 66
temperature: 64
preset_mode: NoHold
friendly_name: Hallway
supported_features: 17
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
# Setting target_temp_high and target_temp_low
2021-03-01 22:54:46 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.lyric] Finished fetching lyric_coordinator data in 0.388 seconds
# Setting temperature
2021-03-01 22:54:54 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.lyric.climate] Set temperature: 68.0
2021-03-01 22:54:56 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.lyric] Finished fetching lyric_coordinator data in 0.409 seconds
```

review_comments:
I think you would have to use the current hvac mode to determine which setpoints should be adjusted. If hvac mode is Auto, then it should set heatSetpoint and coolSetpoint, otherwise, it should change the single setpoint temperature. Something like:
```python
if device.hvac_mode == HVAC_MODE_HEAT_COOL:
```

Not sure if hvac mode `off` would need any special handling? Right now it looks like it displays the single target temp on the dashboard, but should it display anything for the target setpoint?

![Screenshot (Mar 13, 2021 6_36_59 PM)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/27974655/111053717-ca741f00-842b-11eb-8ac3-c2bbd71052ce.jpg)



Hope that helps some!
